0022600086.text: Both the Milwaukee Bucks and Washington Wizards are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with the Bucks on the road. Washington won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 109-99 win over Milwaukee in Washington on January 29, 2026. Milwaukee's Jericho Sims (day-to-day, undisclosed reason) and Nate Ament (day-to-day, ankle sprain) are listed as unavailable, while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip) and has AJ Dybantsa listed as day-to-day with an ankle issue; ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Bucks a 35% chance to win.
